parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 13 - One Piece - Dressrosa Update

Overview

Alien King is a Secret Limited unit. He can only be obtained via completing Alien King's Portal (guaranteed if you are the host).


Evolving

Alien King can evolve into Lord Alien King with the following materials:

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
